caption: The video captures nighttime fireworks over a dark horizon dotted with scattered ground lights and a low bank of illuminated smoke. A large overlapping cluster of bursts fills the upper two-thirds of the frame. It combines an orange-red sphere on the left, a magenta-purple sphere at the top right, green bursts, and a bright pink mass in the middle, with several white and gold peony shells throughout. The cluster remains largely fixed while individual shells expand and brighten. New spherical peony bursts emerge: an orange-white shell on the left grows into a full sphere, a white shell on the right enlarges, and a red-gold shell appears at the top right and widens. A small white burst near the center remains a bright core inside the surrounding red sphere. The smoke bank at the bottom persists, its lit color shifting between pink and pale yellow.
relations: New orange-white, white, and red-gold peony shells emerge and expand into full spheres on the periphery.
The bottom smoke bank persists, its illuminated color shifting dynamically between pink and pale yellow.
The small central white burst remains a bright core inside the surrounding red sphere.
The main cluster stays largely fixed while individual shells continue to expand and brighten.
